case_number: CIVIL APPEAL NOS. 3758 – 3796 /2023; SLP(C) NOS.28258-28296/2018; CONTEMPT PETITION(C) NO.2091/2018; SLP (C) NO. 24344/2014
summary: Enforcement of decree for possession; lis pendens under Transfer of Property Act, 1882 s.52; validity of land transfers during pendency of suit; maintainability of objections to execution; Purchasing Certificates issued under Kerala Land Reform Act, 1963; doctrine of constructive res judicata; decree-holder entitled to possession despite third-party claims; final judgment in 2014; objections by alleged purchasers deemed non-tenants; dismissal of objections upheld; possession ordered to decree-holder.
legal_provisions_cited: Civil Procedure Code, 1908 s.47, Order XXI Rules 97, 98, 100, 102
final_judgment: Appeals allowed; objections to execution dismissed; possession to be delivered to decree-holders; interim order dated 29 June 2018 set aside.
